text:
At this rate, once again
it'll all be over
without my protecting anyone...
Just like that time,
unable to do anything,
once again...
I can't bear it...
Seeing someone get hurt
right in front of me again...
I can't bear it...
Seeing someone get hurt
right in front of me again...
The grief of having
someone precious taken away...
Diiiiie!!
Nooooo!!
Nooooo!!
!?
!?
Uooooooooh...
Aaaaaaah!!
I can't bear
watching anyone
die in front of me again!
Ah...
...
Ugh...
Stay with me,
●!
Stay with me!
Everyone...
You're all right, aren't you...?
Everyone...
Is anyone hurt?
Yes...
Thanks to you,
everyone is safe.

YES...

●!?

us all.

Teacher!?
Teacher!?
Teacher!?

Honestly...

Just unconscious.

ASLEEP...
